copy.en:
Pack Clearly, Adjust Comfortably
Two packing zones and X-shaped straps help keep clothing organized throughout travel.
Separate damp clothing in the dedicated wet-dry pocket
Three handle positions suit different heights
copy.zh:
分区收纳，舒适调节
双区分隔搭配X型固定带，帮助旅途中保持衣物整齐。
干湿分离袋，单独收纳湿衣物
三档拉杆，适配不同身高

Klar packen, bequem anpassen

Feuchte Kleidung im Nass-Trocken-Fach getrennt verstauen
Drei Griffpositionen für unterschiedliche Körpergrößen

copy.it:
Ordine e comfort regolabile
Due zone e cinghie a X aiutano a mantenere ordinati i vestiti in viaggio.
Separa gli indumenti umidi nella tasca dedicata
Tre posizioni del manico per diverse stature
copy.es:
Orden y ajuste cómodo
Dos zonas y correas en X ayudan a mantener la ropa organizada durante el viaje.
Separa las prendas húmedas en el bolsillo dedicado
Tres posiciones del asa para distintas estaturas

design_brief_zh: 本章承接上一章TSA密码锁的查验便利，转向打开箱体后的分类收纳与拉杆调节，避免重复安全卖点。主卖点为涤纶材质内衬，依据为双区分隔、X型固定带、干湿分离袋及三档拉杆。PC画布1464×600采用左文右产品的编辑式构图：产品区约占[x,y,w,h]=[0.43,0.08,0.53,0.85]，展示略高视角打开的银灰或中性色竖纹硬壳行李箱，完整露出涤纶内衬、左右双区、X型固定带和独立干湿分离袋；干燥衣物置于主分区并由固定带整理，湿衣物置于独立袋中。箱体右侧边缘以同一拉杆的三个高度状态做并列对照，不标注具体高度数字。文案区按elements顺序位于左侧：[0.05,0.09,0.33,0.21]放标题“Pack Clearly, Adjust Comfortably”；[0.05,0.32,0.33,0.15]放支持说明，指向双区与X型固定带；[0.05,0.52,0.32,0.17]放干湿分离袋细节；[0.05,0.72,0.32,0.17]放三档拉杆细节。移动端1200×900将打开箱体置于上方产品区[0.18,0.29,0.64,0.39]，三档拉杆状态放在场景右侧；标题与支持说明居中置于顶部，两个细节分别位于底部左右区域，严格遵循标题→支持说明→干湿分离→三档拉杆的阅读顺序。背景使用#F5F3ED浅色底，#01447B作细线或小面积强调，低饱和灰米色欧洲现代旅行摄影，自然侧光，突出涤纶织物纹理、分区边界、固定带和袋体位置。使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题加粗，正文常规字重，德语预留约20%横向扩展空间。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的涤纶内衬、双区分隔、X型固定带、干湿分离袋和三档铝合金拉杆信息。“适配不同身高”遵循指定创意方向，但不添加具体高度范围。不得宣称防水、防漏、抑菌、承重、静音、耐冲击、性能测试或认证；湿衣物仅表达分类收纳用途，不暗示袋体具备未经验证的密封性能。图片不得出现竞品标识、航空公司标识、虚构认证图标或额外品牌文字。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon DE A+ editorial travel scene in a 1464x600 desktop composition and adaptable 1200x900 mobile crop. Use a light warm gray-beige background with restrained navy blue accent lines, low-saturation European modern travel photography, and soft natural side lighting. On desktop, place an open silver or neutral-toned YWJ 13A hard-shell suitcase with vertical ribbed shell and aluminum-colored frame in the right product area, shown from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Clearly show polyester lining texture, two interior packing zones, X-shaped clothing straps securing dry clothes, and a separate wet-dry pocket containing damp clothing. Along the suitcase’s right edge, show the same telescopic handle in three distinct height positions to demonstrate adjustment for different heights, without numerical measurements. Reserve clean negative space on the left for four stacked copy lines in this order: headline, supporting explanation, wet-dry pocket detail, three-position handle detail. For mobile, move the open suitcase and handle comparison to the upper central area and place the four copy regions below, with the two detail callouts arranged side by side. Use crisp sans-serif typography styling but render NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO LOGOS, and NO ICONS in the image; all copy will be added separately.
